name: Tractogram Filtering
summary: Filters anatomically non-plausible streamlines from a .trk tractogram with a geometric deep learning classifier (Astolfi et al., MICCAI 2020), after warping to MNI space with ANTs, and outputs the cleaned tractogram and streamline indexes.
description: Resamples each streamline to 16 points, registers the subject to MNI space using the T1w or FA image (fast SyN by default) and classifies every streamline as anatomically plausible or not with a geometric deep learning network trained on the Petit et al. 2019 definitions. Use it to remove artifactual streamlines from a whole-brain tractogram before bundle segmentation or connectomics. If neither T1w nor FA is given, the tractogram must already be in MNI space. Runs the GPU image of the tool (singularity --nv).

inputs.description: T1w in dwi space. This argument is not required if tractogram is already in the MNI space.
FA image of the subject. This argument is not required if tractogram is already in the MNI space.

outputs.description: A tractogram where artifactual streamlines has been filtered out. The output is in .trk format.
Txt file containing the indexes of anatomically plausible streamline with respect to the input tractogram.
Txt file containing the indexes of anatomically non-plausible streamline with respect to the input tractogram.

parameters.description: This parameter determine the speed of the non linear registration to standard MNI. When set to true it triggers a fast (few mins) but decent non-linear warp computation (search antsRegistrationSynQuick.sh for details). When set to false it triggers a slower (~30mins) but refined non linear registration.

citations.text: Astolfi P. et al. Tractogram Filtering of Anatomically Non-plausible Fibers with Geometric Deep Learning. MICCAI 2020, LNCS 12267.
Avesani P. et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).
